title: Checkout overcharges shipping to Vancouver on bigger orders
body:
A customer in Vancouver complained that shipping on a 3-book order was $72.00. Our rate card says West Canada should be a lot cheaper than that, closer to $32.50.

Steps:
1. Cart: 3 x hardcover (900 g each), subtotal $54.
2. Shipping address: Canada, postal code `v6b 1a1` (the customer typed it lowercase).
3. Quote shows $72.00.

With just one book in the cart the quote looks right ($14.50). Same 3-book cart with the postal code typed as `V6B 1A1` also looks right. Support says they have seen a few of these for other Canadian addresses too, and once an order to `ca` (lowercase country) failed at checkout with an UnsupportedDestination error.

Expected: the quote should not depend on how the customer capitalises or spaces their address.
